comparison.objective: Extract one decommissioned cable through two clips while leaving three live cables retained.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective deformable routing and pulling through clips without disturbing neighboring cables.
comparison.success_condition: Blue cable fully outside the tray and released; grey cables remain under both clips. Numeric disturbance tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: It tests selective cable extraction and deformable manipulation, not rigid notch fracture or fragment containment.
